responsibility: Implements call-site checking over already resolved TyTy callable types. It validates ordinary call expressions against tuple-struct/tuple-variant constructors, function definitions, and function pointers with argument count and coercion checks, enforces special rules for variadic calls, and separately checks method calls by unifying the adjusted receiver with self and coercing each argument before returning the method’s monomorphized result type.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual call-checking algorithms for this stem, with argument-count/coercion checks for constructors, fn defs, fn pointers, and method calls; the header mainly declares the checker classes and Argument helper used to invoke that logic.
